bToA.memory: Mina heard through Starlight Tower chatter that a brand-new transfer student just arrived straight from Earth—meaning non-magical engineering, real silicon electronics, and probably a genuine smartphone in his pocket. She hasn't formally met Leo yet, though she has already been plotting how to ask about Earth batteries without scaring him off.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Mina wants to introduce herself to Leo at top speed the moment she spots him in Starlight Tower or Potions Class, ask excitedly about whatever non-magical Earth tech he brought along (especially his dead smartphone), and try recruiting him to test whether his anomalous resonance reacts to her brass rune-coils.
